credentialLabeledPublicReportFilenames.interpretation: Filename alone neither proves a secret nor approves publication. Existing public-evidence redaction verifier must inspect sanitized content before staging.

hazards: The .log global ignore is not excepted for these four curated roots; stage only explicit verified top-level log names with force, never force-add an audit root recursively.
Dot baselines/temporary generated files can be unignored. The starts-with-dot exclusion is essential even when a suffix is allowed.
Nested browser traces, archives, profiles and generated/private directories are not selected. Never add screenshot directories recursively; use the exact PNG list.
The extension allowlist omits .patch and .ts proposals. Documentation links require separate reviewed exact-file selection or explicit exclusion; do not silently broaden the suffix policy.
Top-level public filename/size is only a publication candidate. Content/redaction review remains separate.
PNG header dimensions are metadata, not a fresh visual/layout pass. Historical static whole-run failures are retained and do not imply the screenshot itself is private or invalid.
The index contains85 earlier staged changes; do not assume those equal current final17 working-tree bytes. Parent must reconcile partial staging before commit.
publicationSizeMeaning: Uncompressed file bytes only, not an estimate of compressed Git object/pack or hosting package size.
notPerformed: No private credential/config/storage or trace/profile content read
No content secret scan or public-evidence safety approval
